scope: Static, calibrated capability links; not live incident assertions or attacker-intent labels

bridge_assertions.meaning: The SPHERE real controller was observed answering a general interrogation in a calibration episode; no attack intent inferred.
The real controller supplied trusted observations for IOAs 11, 12 and 13 during calibration; no maliciousness inferred.
The real controller confirmed IEC-104 SELECT in calibration; this does not assert EXECUTE or physical manipulation.
The isolated decoy completed an authorized IEC-104 control transaction during calibration; it is not a real-grid impact.
Decoy-side active-power requested values 200 kW then 400 kW were executed during calibration; neither is evidence of real-plant actuation.

unapproved_general_cyber_mappings.reason: Name or broad attack-technique similarity is insufficient to justify GeneralCyber-to-ICSCyber or GeneralCyber-to-ComponentTopology edges.
